tags: Neo-Soul: A warm, organic neo-soul track dripping with live instrumentation and effortless groove. A live drummer plays a loose, hip-hop influenced pocket—soft kick drum with lazy swing, snare hits that sit just behind the beat, and brushed hi-hats that breathe and shuffle with human imperfection.
lyrics:
[Intro - Guitar Riff & Drums]
mm…yeah…let it breathe…

[Verse 1]
Late night glow on your skin
Window cracked, city hums again
Coffee rings on the table top
Time don't rush, it just drops

Loose kick drum, heart runs slow
Snare talks back, says "take it low"
Every step just slightly late
Still we land right on the faith

[Verse]
Your laugh swings behind the beat
Barefoot dancing on the street
Nothing polished, nothing tight
Feels more real that way tonight

Brush those hats, let them slide
Leave some space where truth can hide
If it falls, let it fall
That's the soul inside it all

[Pre-Chorus]
No count-in for this kind of love
We don't line it up
We just lean and trust

[Chorus]
Stay right there, don't pull it straight
I love how we arrive late
Off the grid but locked in time
That lazy swing feels like mine
Yeah we bend, we drift, we sway
Let tomorrow wait its turn today
If love lives just off the line
Soft kick drum, your hand in mine

[Outro - Guitar Riff & Final Chord]
no rush…no rush…just groove…

tags: Lo-Fi Hip Hop: A hazy, tape-saturated lo-fi beat built for late-night headphone sessions. Dusty vinyl crackle sits underneath a mellow Rhodes piano loop with detuned chords that drift in and out of tune. A boom-bap drum machine lays down a slow, head-nodding groove with a punchy kick and a snare drenched in reverb.
lyrics:
[Intro - Piano Loop & Vinyl Crackle]
...

[Verse 1]
Rain taps glass like a metronome
Blue light hums, I'm here alone
Pages turn but the words blur out
Static fills what I think about

Dusty keys, a broken phrase
Looping back through purple haze
Nothing moves but the second hand
Slipping through like grains of sand

[Verse 2]
Old voicemail I won't delete
Your laugh still makes the loop complete
Faded photo on the wall
Small things hold the most of all

Bass drops low beneath the floor
Kick drum knocks like an open door
Let it ride, no need to change
Comfort lives inside the strange

[Chorus]
Rewind the night, press play again
Same four bars, same old friend
Nothing new but nothing wrong
Just a beat that hums along

[Outro - Tape Stop]
...yeah...

tags: Cumbia Electrónica: A modern electronic cumbia fusion blending traditional Colombian rhythms with synth textures. A güira scrapes out the classic cumbia shuffle while an 808 sub-bass pulses underneath. Accordion melodies weave through shimmering arpeggiated synths and hand percussion.
lyrics:
[Intro - Güira & Synth Pad]
dale…dale…

[Verso 1]
Sale el sol por el malecón
Pies descalzos, cumbia y ron
La marea sube y baja igual
Como el ritmo que no para ya

Acordeón entre las olas
Sintetizador que vuela sola
Bajo tierra tiembla el beat
Y la calle empieza a arder

[Verso 2]
Manos arriba, cintura baja
El amanecer no tiene prisa
Luces de neón sobre la playa
Cada paso deja su sonrisa

[Coro]
Baila hasta que salga el sol
Que la cumbia no pide razón
Pie derecho, corazón
El ritmo es la conversación

[Outro - Accordion Fade]
una vez más…una vez más…
